answer: A zero-knowledge age-range proof lets an agent prove it is over eighteen without revealing its birthdate: the issuer signs the birth year, the agent proves the range in ZK, and a Sybil farm cannot mint adult identities without one real issued credential per account. A lone pigment cannot fake an age history; only the whole record counts. When the whisper settles over the sonnet, the age holds because every claim carried its own proof.
